top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 70 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The FEC's request for additional information (RFAI) letters and Form 99 correspondence received since October 29 were all covered in prior editions, so there is nothing new to list. No red-flag keyword hits and no voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more turned up in new data.

sections.headline: $298,200 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 1 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $298,200 in all. Largest target: Ken Paxton (support, $298,200). 1 spender(s) registered in the last 180 days.

items: Constitutional Vanguard Super PAC: $298,200 — registered 9/5/2026, a new committee

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/29/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (form FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 29, 2026 onward, as of the Sunday, November 1, 2026 PM edition. 70 filings were in the window and all were already reported.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.

apod.caption: What color is the Moon? It depends on the night -- and the time.
